actual_scope: On the selected #6030 word, the absolute phase of each MOVE chart change U=chart(a)^† chart(b) satisfies U^{(⊗)f}=i^{p f} U_0^{(⊗)f}, and i^{p f}=i^p for every column multiplicity f≥1 if and only if p=0. 1809 of 2886 distinct MOVE operators have p≠0.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one assumption ID and one quantified implication at the actual caller. The assumption is native_all_columns. The implication is the tensor-power phase of MOVE, not a discharge of all five assumptions. #5837 already lifted SCALE/ADD/COPY on the older #5599 word; this word is the selected #6030 program.
bottleneck_link: Side result; no new kappa. An all-width reading of native_all_columns that keeps the width-1 phase integer mis-signs 2117 MOVE events at width 2. The corrected phase is i^{p f}. The other four assumptions and the selected exponent stay in place.
stop_rule: Stop after this phase law and the exhaustive census of the selected word's MOVE operators. Do not rerun the width-1 native replay or search for a new helper split.
evidence: PROOF.md Lemmas A-C. verify.py prints PASS_MOVE_CHART_PHASE_POWER with nontrivial_pairs=1809, nontrivial_events=2117, only_new_pairs=78 and only_new_events=103.
